run the SAM2 video checkpoint converter CLI tool with model name and checkpoint path
get a Sam2VideoConfig for a specified SAM2 model variant
replace and remap state dict keys from original SAM2 to HuggingFace naming convention
push the converted SAM2 model and processor to the HuggingFace Hub
run SAM2-Video inference on a video using point or mask prompts to track objects across frames
create a Sam2VideoInferenceSession to manage video inference state, cached features, and per-object tracking data
build the Sam2VideoMaskDecoder that predicts segmentation masks from image embeddings and sparse prompt embeddings
test propagating object tracking through all video frames via Sam2VideoModel.propagate_in_video_iterator
review the Sam2VideoMemoryAttention module that fuses current vision features with memory from previous frames using RoPE attention
run video object segmentation inference on a frame using Sam2VideoModel.forward
run video object tracking propagation through all frames using Sam2VideoModel.propagate_in_video_iterator
create a video inference session using Sam2VideoProcessor.init_video_session
add point, box, or mask inputs to a video inference session using Sam2VideoProcessor.add_inputs_to_inference_session
create a Sam2VideoConfig instance with custom memory attention and mask decoder settings
initialize a SAM2 video inference session for processing video frames with specified device and dtype
process images with input points, labels, and bounding boxes into normalized tensors for the model
add interactive points or bounding boxes to a specific video frame in an inference session
add segmentation masks to a specific video frame in an inference session
post-process raw model masks by removing padding, upsampling, and binarizing to original image size
create a Sam2VideoVideoProcessor instance for preprocessing video frames with 1024x1024 resizing and normalization
preprocess a batch of video tensors by resizing to 1024x1024, normalizing with ImageNet stats, and returning batch feature with original and reshaped sizes
post-process batched segmentation masks by removing padding, upscaling to original image size, and optionally binarizing with a threshold
build a BatchFeature object containing pixel values, original sizes, and reshaped input sizes for a batch of video tensors
test the video processing pipeline by preprocessing video tensors and post-processing the resulting segmentation masks
